virtualminecraft.msg.linked: Monitor linked to the nearest computer
virtualminecraft.msg.not_linked: This monitor is not linked to a computer (place it within 8 blocks of one, or use /vmc link)
virtualminecraft.msg.too_many: Too many virtual machines are running
virtualminecraft.msg.no_permission: You need to be an operator to control virtual machines
virtualminecraft.msg.drive_full: There is already a disk in this drive
virtualminecraft.msg.not_removable: Only floppies and CDs fit in a disk drive; hard drives go inside the computer
virtualminecraft.msg.floppy_needs_drive: Floppies go in a disk drive placed against the computer
virtualminecraft.msg.computer_full: This computer already holds %s disks (sneak + right-click to take one out)
virtualminecraft.msg.stop_first: Shut the computer down before changing its disks
virtualminecraft.msg.restart_for_drive: This drive was added while the computer ran — restart it to use the drive
virtualminecraft.msg.suspended_medium: The computer is suspended; it will boot fresh with the new medium
virtualminecraft.msg.no_bootable: No bootable device — see the monitor
virtualminecraft.msg.modem_status: Modem: range %s blocks, %s modem(s) in range, %s computer(s) reachable; %s on this bus
virtualminecraft.msg.modem_no_computer: No computer touches this modem or its bus cable — it reaches nothing yet
virtualminecraft.msg.iso_outside: ISO must be a file in the server's ISO folder — the path you set was ignored
virtualminecraft.tooltip.extra_args: Extra QEMU arguments are host-level access, so they can only be set on the server (config file or /vmc args).
virtualminecraft.msg.bridge_unpaired: This bridge has no id, so it joins nothing. Sneak+right-click it to give it a new one, or right-click it holding another bridge to pair them.
virtualminecraft.msg.bridge_alone: Bridge %s: the other half is not placed anywhere yet.
virtualminecraft.msg.bridge_linked: Bridge %s -> %s; %s cable run(s) reachable from here.
virtualminecraft.msg.bridge_paired: Paired: the bridge in your hand now carries id %s. Place it anywhere to join the two runs.
virtualminecraft.msg.bridge_new_id: This bridge has a new id (%s) and is no longer linked to whatever it was paired with.
